notes.title: Winter Sale and Future Update
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, video game enthusiasts![/b]

Welcome to the New Year, and we wish you a year filled with fantastic games and success in all your endeavors. As for our project, a bit of luck wouldn't hurt us either. Today, we unveil what we've been diligently working on for quite some time:

Rethinking the shooter level and its development took us significantly longer than anticipated. In the [u][b]UPCOMING [/b][/u]update, you can expect:

[b]Blockville:[/b]
On a large open level, you will encounter numerous quests and activities that will unveil the history of this place and dispel any boredom. Immerse yourself in the life of this extraordinary city!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392542/30bc9347bf92c90f66cf7f2ba6f198961f90dce4.gif[/img]

[b]New Movement System:[/b]
A new movement system will allow you to reach new heights! Double jumps, platforms for leaping, speed boosters, reduced gravity, and much more!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392542/c04b311e45c8221bbe587f5d6d3314edd11fb1d5.gif[/img]

[b]Increased Weapon Variety:[/b]
Currently, the game offers three types of weapons. Each weapon is unique and requires a specific type of ammunition.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392542/715bdfe7df3f6ae8ab57a3ab0d28c1054732dd9c.gif[/img]


[b]New Enemies:[/b]
With the introduction of new weapons, new adversaries are needed! These new enemies won't give you a break, and the new Swordsmen with teleportation abilities won't leave you in peace!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392542/6dd73c1356fee52cdf0c1f8c8bc16598d5b3dada.gif[/img]

[b]Expanded Map:[/b]
Shooter Map 2 has become quite an extensive map, featuring everything from arenas for enemy skirmishes to a substantial open map with numerous activities.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392542/50eb533ea065945fb03e8ef54dee554f2d04023c.gif[/img]

[b]New Boss Fights:[/b]
On the new map, you will also face new and thrilling boss battles. The update is currently in the final stages. We are working on sounds, balance, and fixing any remaining bugs. Additionally, we are enhancing the RPG level for better player immersion. And much more!

[i][u][b]Thank you all for your support! With love for players,[/b][/u][/i]
Extela Games

notes.title: Autumn Sale is here!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, all video game enthusiasts![/b]

Greetings to everyone with the start of the autumn sale. However, we must warn you, dear friends, that unfortunately, we are still not on track with the new map. Honestly, we got a bit carried away with it, but we hope you'll like it when it's finally ready! Currently, we are also working on adding new languages to the game.
While we were busy with development, we kind of forgot that, before the game's release, as true AAA developers, we prepared this letter of joy for you.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392542/a97380d1ecea5dc140d04b79f4d4f66b02ebacb8.png[/img]



[strike]P.S. Hope we don't have to explain the joke...[/strike]

[u][i][b]With love for the players,[/b][/i][/u]
Extela Games

notes.title: Pre-patch ( Patch 1.1.1. )
notes.content:
[u][b]Greetings, video game enthusiasts![/b][/u]

[b]We present to you the pre-patch build[/b]. As the name suggests, it's not everything we promised, but we won't delay any further with critical fixes. In this game version, you'll find:

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Improved project optimization.
[*] Added support for FSR and DLSS (highly recommended to use).
[*] Localization fixes.
[*] RPG map death issues.
[*] Additions:
[/list]

Added:
[list]
[*] Achievements.
[*] Quest markers.
[*] New RPG quests.
[*] Enhanced save system.
[*] Continuation of the horror level.
[*] Damage display system on RPG levels.
[*] Death animation in the shooter part.
[*] Overheat effect for rifles.
[/list]
[b]We apologize to our dear players [/b]for delaying the big update and not fulfilling all our promises yet. The materials we've been working on so far don't meet our expectations and desires as game creators. We had a difficult start on Steam, and we don't want to repeat our mistakes. So, at this stage, we're testing a new map for the shooter part, as well as new quests, and we're actively working on the horror level.

[u][b]We plan to release a major patch on November 21, along with our first discount! Don't miss it![/b][/u]

[u][b]With love for our players,[/b][/u]
[i]Extela Games team[/i]

notes.title: We're back on track!
notes.content:
[b]Hello, video game enthusiasts! [/b]
We're back with some great news! [u][b]We're back in action![/b][/u]
Currently, we've completed [u]half of our work! [/u] We've also decided to share some of the results of our efforts with you! Of course, we can't spoil the quests for you, but trust us, there are some very interesting ones.

As you can see in the picture quests are more visible, as they are shown to the player with an old-school mark.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392542/71907c265b8a5e957df7137d98887e367353a897.png[/img]

We also added a damage counter for the RPG level to make you understand better how much damage you deal.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392542/cbecd2ee71adeb5b6b8f5feace3c5922d822a889.gif[/img]
We've also significantly improved the game optimization and added some exciting features, such as FSR support and DLSS settings.

At the moment, we're working on a map for the Shooter level and Achievements.
We even had a chance to do some work on the Horror map
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44392542/0afe42fd836f050abcd6276115ffcffbfe72a1a8.gif[/img]
Work on the update is still going on!
[u][b]Thank you all for your support, with love for gamers,[/b][/u]
Extela Games.

notes.title: Delay and more information about update
notes.content:
Hello, video game enthusiasts! 
Unfortunately, we regret to inform you of yet another delay in the release of the update. We will announce the release date at a later time.

As an apology this time, we will share some interesting facts about this upcoming update and the reasons for the delays!

[b]In this update, you can expect:[/b]

[olist]
[*] Achievements.
[*] A large number of exciting mechanical quests.
[*] Enhanced navigation system on the RPG map.
[*] Optimization improvements.
[*] New Localizations
[/olist]

Unfortunately, the reasons for the delays include not only our desire to expand the content but also the illness of many of our developers who have contracted COVID-19. This has significantly slowed down the work process.

We sincerely apologize for this inconvenience!
[i][u][b]With love for our players,[/b][/u][/i]
The Extela Games Team.

notes.title: Update Delay!
notes.content:

notes.title: Future update plans
notes.content:
[b]Greetings, video game enthusiasts!
Your support has been absolutely incredible! You are the best![/b]

Let's start with some good news. Our team has received enough feedback to move forward, so we've made some adjustments to the content development plan for our game.

First and foremost, our primary goal is to enhance the content for our players, and we're currently expanding the RPG level. This expansion includes:

[olist]
[*] An increase in the number of quests.
[*] A new system for acquiring additional quests to make them easier to find.
[*] New enemies.
[*] A new character leveling system.
[*] Game balance improvements.
[/olist]

We also received a lot of feedback on the "Shooter" level, so for this map, you can expect:

[olist]
[*] Map expansion.
[*] An increase in the variety of weapons.
[*] New enemies.
[*] New movement mechanics.
[*] Reduced initial game discomfort.
[/olist]

And, of course, we'll be fixing bugs, bugs, and more bugs.

We plan to release this [i][u][b]update within 2 weeks[/b][/u][/i] and then continue working on the "Horror" level.

Once again, thank you all for your support, and we apologize for the issues during the launch.
[i][b]With love for our players,[/b][/i]
Extela Games Studio.

notes.title: Update 1.1
notes.content:
[b]Welcome, video game enthusiasts![/b]

Despite a challenging start, our team continues to work on fixing technical errors that were initially unforeseen and implementing features to enhance the gaming experience. There are still bugs in the game that might affect your enjoyment, but we are doing everything possible to fix them.

[u][b]General Fixes[/b][/u]

Bug reports poured in like rotten tomatoes, but thanks to all who supported the project and showed interest in it. Your diligence led to the resolution of the following types of issues:

[i][u][b]NOTE: Some of ENG Narrator voice lines are still in development, so if some times you hear UA Narrator its ok. We will fixed that as soon as ENG Voice Actor will be back from vacation. [/b][/u][/i]

[list]
[*] Fixed. Issue with game download across different interface languages.
[*] Fixed. Issue with incorrect display of quest markers on the RPG map.
[*] Fixed. Issue with the sound of opening the journal not working.
[*] Fixed. Issue that prevented loading on the RPG map during the first attempt.
[*] Fixed. Issue, where character sounds in the dragon quest, wasn't triggering.
[*] Fixed. Issue where the internal dialogue wasn't showing after defeating the Jackal.
[*] Fixed. Issue where no reward was given after defeating the Jackal.
[*] Fixed. Issue where sound settings weren't saving.
[*] Fixed. Issue where audio and interface sound didn't match the settings, mixing Ukrainian and English sounds.
[*] Fixed. Issue with subtitle overlay.
[*] Fixed. Issue where the lift to transition to another level appeared before defeating the RPG map boss.
[*] Fixed. Issue where player's gear on the RPG map didn't provide additional HP/MP/Endurance/Damage points.
[*] Fixed. Issue where attacking directly from Block on the RPG map caused invulnerability.
[*] Fixed. Issue where the player could remain stuck during a time-based quest, causing it to malfunction.
[*] Fixed. Issue where 1 slain NPC counted as 2 for a quest.
[*] Fixed. Issue where the player couldn't attack after a roll.
[*] Fixed. Issue where the player couldn't roll while blocking.
[*] Fixed. Issue where additional damage wasn't applied for a strong attack.
[*] Fixed. Issue where the narrator's line didn't trigger when transitioning from RPG to Horror level.
[*] Fixed. Issue where the RPG map boss spawned additional enemies in the texture.
[/list]

[i][u][b]General Additions[/b][/u][/i]

We're also diligently working on adding new content for you, our beloved players. Here's a list of what we've added:

[list]
[*] Added. Character statistics window on the RPG level.
[*] Added. New sound for leveling up on the RPG map.
[*] Added. New sounds for the dragon quest.
[*] Added. F5 / F6 keys for quick save and load.
[*] Added. New sound for equipping gear.
[/list]

[i][u][b]General Changes[/b][/u][/i]

Among bug reports, we also noticed player complaints about excessive difficulty on the RPG level. Therefore, the following parameters were changed:

[list]
[*] Changed. Strong attack damage increased.
[*] Changed. First ability damage increased.
[/list]

[u][b]A Few Words from the Development Team and What to Expect Next[/b][/u]

Special thanks to players for their support and feedback. You're simply amazing! Your help allowed us to improve the game and community hub, and your feedback indicated we're heading in the right direction! We hope not to disappoint your expectations. In the near future, we'll add new quests to the RPG map, and we're already working on a new Horror-style level. Follow us on social media and join our community hub to receive timely updates.

[b]With love,[/b]
Extela Games.

notes.title: "GameDev Trash" will be available on 17 August
notes.content:
Greetings, video game enthusiasts!

Soon, our satirical game "GameDev Trash" will be released in early access to a wide audience. Therefore, we would like to remind you that early access primarily involves communication between players and developers. We would greatly appreciate your feedback on the game's mechanics, concepts, and more. Additionally, please keep in mind that the game is filled with both minor and major bugs. As a result, we would like to inform you of the following. If you encounter issues related to localization in your language or critical bugs, such as inaccurately marked task objectives, please contact us at support@extelagames.com.

We intend to collaborate with the gaming community to develop not only a humorous and entertaining game but also to showcase to other developers that there is still room for experimentation with concepts and mechanics in modern game development, to create something new and unique.

With respect to the players,
The Extela Games company.

P.S. The apology letter is already prepared!

notes.title: GameDev Trash in Steam!
notes.content:
[b]Greetings to all game enthusiasts![/b]
We are excited to announce that after extensive development, we have finally made it to Steam. You probably haven't heard of GameDev Trash before. It's not just a game, but more of an experimental creation driven by creativity and a desire to create something truly new. We put all our efforts into making a game that manipulates player actions, breaks the fourth wall, laughs at modern trends, and gives average gamers a glimpse into game development.

[b]Why Early Access?[/b]
Initially, the game was intended to be smaller, but during RPG-level development, we got carried away and created a massive 12.5 square kilometer map, a real challenge for a 3-person indie studio. Besides we really need player feedback to continue our development.

[b]What do you mean by manipulating player actions?[/b]
Each boss is uniquely designed with mechanics that manipulate different aspects of the game. For example, Junior Dev Boss can break the game's codes, causing FPS drops or changing your control keys, and so on.

[b]What do you mean by revealing the development process?[/b]
The game's plot revolves around the entire game development process, from start to finish. The first level is in the style of a so-called "Blockout," the initial stage when a game takes shape. The game's story humorously explores game development in the modern game dev industry.

[b]Is each level a full-fledged game?[/b]
We aimed to make each level self-contained and almost like a full-fledged game, albeit with somewhat simplified mechanics, but close enough to be considered a standalone experience.

[b]Do you plan to add voiceovers in other languages?[/b]
Unfortunately, at this stage of development, we can't consider additional voiceover languages due to limited resources. However, after the release, we do plan to add them.

We hope these brief answers give you a better idea of the game we're creating. If you have further questions, feel free to reach out via email [b][u]support@extelagames.com.[/u][/b]
